basic_details.job_title: FACT Barge Master Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore Limited (FACT), a Schedule 'A' multi-divisional Central PSE, invites applications for one post type, Barge Master on Fixed Tenure Contract (Adhoc Basis), for empanelment / engagement. Applications must be sent by Speed Post, Registered Post or Courier to DGM (HR), HR Department, FEDO Building, Udyogamandal, Kochi – 683501, or dropped in the specified drop box at the HR Department. Applications received later than 4.00 PM on 09 December 2026 will not be considered.

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Barge Master on Fixed Tenure Contract (Adhoc Basis) (Post Code 01)

qualification.details: Qualification: minimum of valid Second Class Masters Certificate under Kerala Inland Vessels Rules. Experience: minimum of one year post qualification experience as Master in a Boat/Barge/Ship. Candidates with experience in Inland Water Ways of Kochi will be given preference. Age: maximum of 62 years and not less than 22 years. Candidates should have been born on or between 01.11.1964 and 31.10.2004. The relevant date for age, experience and qualification is 01.11.2026. Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/Ex-Service candidates may apply provided they fulfil the eligibility standards prescribed for the post; no relaxation in age / experience is applicable. Reservation for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS and Ex-Servicemen applies as per Government Directives. Only post qualification experience is considered. Part time or daily wage experience is not considered, other than direct engagement by PSUs / Government Departments / Autonomous Bodies; for such daily wage engagement the employer must certify the days worked in each year, or the candidate must submit sufficient proof. Pay: a 3% increase on successful completion of each year. A higher initial consolidated pay at 3% for every completed year of relevant experience in FACT as on the date of engagement, if any, will be considered. Allowances: Trip Allowance of Rs.1000/- per trip and Food Allowance of Rs.200/- per day worked. Accident Insurance and Provident Fund apply based on eligibility, as per Rules of the Company. No other allowance / remuneration / benefits are payable. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

selection_process: Empanelment of candidates will follow passing in the practical/skill test. Candidates successful in the test are assessed and ranked on merit. In case of a tie in marks
ranking is decided in this order:

Completed years of relevant experience in Inland Water Ways of Kochi Completed years of relevant experience Earlier year of acquiring minimum Second Class Master Certificate as per KIV Rules Earlier date of birth
The Management reserves the right to short list candidates by methods or criteria it finds suitable and to modify the mode of selection. Meeting the eligibility criteria
attending or being successful in the skill test does not by itself confer any right to selection
inclusion in the Panel or engagement. Candidates from the panel may be considered for engagement for shorter periods too
at rates/terms fixed by the Company.
important_instructions: The engagement is for two years, renewable for a maximum of 2 spells of one year each, at the discretion of the Management, subject to requirement, performance, assessment etc. It may be terminated by the Management without notice and without assigning any reason. The engagement gives no right to extension or permanent appointment. Pre-employment medical examination by the Company's Medical Officer is required; only those certified fit will be offered appointment. No relaxation in medical/physical standards. Engaged candidates work on the vessel for continuous 15 days and are off for the next 15 days. No other leave is admissible. The navigation route is through the Inland Water Ways with narrow canals and bridges. The incumbent is liable to serve anywhere in India if required. Incomplete applications, applications without signature and photograph, or without documents proving eligibility are liable to be rejected. Further notifications will appear on www.fact.co.in. Individual communication is only through the e-mail id given in the application, so the e-mail id and phone number must be legible, valid and functional. Applications of candidates not included in the Panel are retained for not more than one year; selection documents are preserved for two years from the date of publication of the Panel. Disputes are settled in courts within the jurisdiction of Ernakulam, Kerala State only.

Applications sent by e-mail are liable to be rejected.

rows.post: Barge Master on Fixed Tenure Contract (Adhoc Basis) (Post Code 01)

content_sections.heading: FACT Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Duty includes managing / leading a crew consisting of Engine Drivers and Lascars for operating Ammonia Barges of FACT, as per directions from FACT. Masters shall acquire additional requirements, if any, stipulated from time to time under Kerala Inland Vessels Rules or by Government or Statutory Agencies like Directorate of Ports, CPT, and District Authorities etc. to operate Barges, including transport of hazardous materials like Ammonia.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed application format, duly filled, with signature and photograph Self-attested copies of certificates proving qualification, Master certificate, age, experience, caste etc Experience certificate showing experience in the relevant field; those presently working must submit reasonable proof of employment in the relevant field EWS candidates: EWS certificate of relevant year (income of 2025-26) OBC-NCL candidates: self-declaration in the prescribed format provided on the website and OBC-NCL certificate; if engaged, an OBC-NCL certificate issued by the competent authority within 6 months prior to joining Originals of the documents must be furnished as and when called for.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Empanelment of candidates will follow passing in the practical/skill test. Candidates successful in the test are assessed and ranked on merit. In case of a tie in marks, ranking is decided in this order: Completed years of relevant experience in Inland Water Ways of Kochi Completed years of relevant experience Earlier year of acquiring minimum Second Class Master Certificate as per KIV Rules Earlier date of birth The Management reserves the right to short list candidates by methods or criteria it finds suitable and to modify the mode of selection. Meeting the eligibility criteria, attending or being successful in the skill test does not by itself confer any right to selection, inclusion in the Panel or engagement. Candidates from the panel may be considered for engagement for shorter periods too, at rates/terms fixed by the Company.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the FACT Barge Master post?
faq.answer: Applications received later than 4.00 PM on 09.12.2026 will not be considered.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for FACT Barge Master?
faq.answer: A minimum of valid Second Class Masters Certificate under Kerala Inland Vessels Rules and a minimum of one year post qualification experience as Master in a Boat/Barge/Ship.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for FACT Barge Master?
faq.answer: Maximum of 62 years and not less than 22 years, with candidates born on or between 01.11.1964 and 31.10.2004. The relevant date is 01.11.2026, and no age relaxation applies to SC/ST/OBC/Ex-Service candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of FACT Barge Master?
faq.answer: Consolidated pay of Rs.31,000/- per month, with a 3% increase on completion of each year, plus Trip Allowance of Rs.1000/- per trip and Food Allowance of Rs.200/- per day worked.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the FACT Barge Master post?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed application format with self-attested copies of certificates by Speed Post, Registered Post or Courier to DGM (HR), HR Department, FEDO Building, Udyogamandal, Kochi – 683501, or drop it in the specified drop box at the HR Department.

faq.question: Q6. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope must be superscribed with "Application for the post of Barge Master - Ad.11/2026".

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply by e-mail?
faq.answer: No. The notice says applications sent by e-mail are liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for FACT Barge Master?
faq.answer: Empanelment follows passing the practical/skill test. Successful candidates are ranked on merit, with ties decided by Inland Water Ways of Kochi experience, relevant experience, year of acquiring the Second Class Master Certificate and then date of birth.

faq.question: Q9. Is the FACT Barge Master job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a fixed tenure contract of two years, renewable for a maximum of 2 spells of one year each at the Management's discretion, and it confers no right to permanent appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the Barge Master work?
faq.answer: The place of work is Udyogamandal, Ambalamedu and Willingdon Island at Kochi, where the Ammonia Barge is used to transport Ammonia to and from various Divisions of FACT.
